description: Resolve a US patent or application number (e.g. US1234567B2) via USPTO Open Data Portal and optionally join the indexed prior-art corpus. Returns title, status, CPC, grant-text excerpt, and a public URL. No API key required in the MCP client.

include_grant_text.description: Fetch abstract / claim 1 excerpt when available (default true).

patent_id.description: US patent id (US1234567B2) or application number.

name: precheck_lookup_patent
title: Patent PreCheck — US patent lookup
